identityDecision: Use the centroid of the restored Basmo donjon and main-fort ruin as the stable physical anchor while retaining the wider fortress and forterrain as historical context.

historicalScope.source: Store norske leksikon – Basmo festning; Marker kommune – Basmo festning
historicalScope.finding: The donjon and main fort occupied the highest point on a steep hill between Rødenessjøen and Hemnessjøen. The wider fortress included batteries, outworks, a southern retrenchment and approximately 40 buildings, and therefore extended far beyond the surviving main ruin.
historicalScope.visitorIdentity: The main fort is partially restored and freely accessible; restoration of the lower stone levels continues.

crossChecks.finding: The fortress and cultural-property entity lies approximately 34.1 metres from the applied building centroid and links Kulturminne ID 86068.
The official local source documents the first five-storey, 18-metre tower in 1683, approximately 40 buildings, closure in 1745, protection in 1985 and continuing restoration.
